saw_lines: Occasion dress buyers check price, fabric and delivery date before they commit, because the dress has to arrive in time.
So a buyer who cannot see the price or arrival date leaves for a store that shows both in line one.
Your 4 of 10 ads open on the same anniversary sale line. Write two or three new openers from your own dresses and test them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Oct 2026
points: 4 of 10 ads open on the same 30% off anniversary line, so one opener carries the account. New buyers see one message. Write two or three new angles from your own dresses and test each against it.

Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 10 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer choosing for a holiday date gets no answer before the click. Open two new ads with your free standard shipping line in the first sentence.
Your site lists dresses from $78 to $228, yet 0 of 10 ads show a price, so buyers cannot judge value before the click. Lead one ad with the $78 starting price and note it is the same in every size.

One exact copy runs in 4 of 10 ads, so the same words reach the same audience again and again. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each, so every ad tests a new first sentence.
